title: East Anglian Championships
text:
The EAOA chairman, Paul Beckett, will hold the prize-giving for the East Anglian Championships towards the end of the event, hopefully before 2pm, weather, finishers and results permitting. To ensure that everything runs smoothly, could all 2015 age class winners please ensure that their trophies are engraved and brought along to our Tunstall Forest event on 14th February?

Presentations for the 2015 East Anglian League class winners will also take place at the same ceremony.
